note: PLACEHOLDER content — edit freely. Each figure: en, ar, type (prophet|imam), era (birth / time period they lived through), and readings[] of one or more assignments. A reading needs a label; url is optional (link to a Quran passage via ../../quran/text/?s=SURAH&from=A&to=B&trans=1&title=..., a materials file, or an outside page). excerpt is optional short text shown inline.

figures.era: The first human and the first prophet — before all recorded history.

readings.label: The creation of Adam and the command to the angels
readings.excerpt: Allah teaches Adam the names of all things and commands the angels to prostrate.

figures.era: Lived among a people who worshipped idols for generations; called them for 950 years.

readings.label: Surah Nuh — his call to his people
readings.excerpt: Night and day he invited them — openly and in secret — to seek forgiveness.

figures.era: Born in Mesopotamia in the time of a tyrant king; father of prophets through Ismail and Ishaq.

readings.label: Ibrahim reasons with his people about the stars, moon, and sun

figures.era: Born in Egypt under Pharaoh's rule, when the sons of Bani Israil were being killed.

readings.label: Musa's birth and rescue from the river
readings.excerpt: His mother is inspired to place him in the river; Allah returns him to her.

figures.era: Born in Makkah in the Year of the Elephant (~570 CE); received revelation at 40.

readings.label: The Year of the Elephant — the year of his birth
readings.excerpt: Surah Al-Fil recalls the army with the elephant that came against the Ka'bah.

figures.era: Born inside the Ka'bah (~600 CE); raised in the Prophet's ﷺ household; the first Imam.

readings.label: The night of the Hijrah — sleeping in the Prophet's ﷺ bed
readings.excerpt: When the Prophet ﷺ left Makkah, Ali stayed behind in his place, giving himself for the Messenger's safety, and later returned every trust to its owner.

figures.era: Grandson of the Prophet ﷺ (b. 626 CE); the third Imam; martyred at Karbala in 61 AH / 680 CE.

readings.label: Karbala and the day of Ashura
readings.excerpt: In Muharram of 61 AH, Imam Husayn stood with his family and companions at Karbala rather than accept injustice — a stand remembered every year on Ashura.
